identity.name: Plutus Predict
identity.vibe: Control Room / Retro-Futurism / High-Frequency Trading Terminal
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Terminal aesthetics with modern Fintech usability.
Content is King: Data is the hero. Use monospaced fonts for all metrics.
Zoom In: Focus on the probability percentages.
Negative Space: Use dense grids but leave breathing room within cells.
Contrast: High contrast neon against deep void backgrounds.

headings.usage: Page titles, Section headers, Card titles

usage_rules: Never use pure black (#000000) for backgrounds, use #050505.
Use Primary (#00E5FF) for active states, main actions, and high-probability indicators.
Use Secondary (#00FF94) for success states and positive trends.
Use Destructive (#FF3333) for high-risk warnings and negative trends.

strategies: Dashboard: Dense grid (grid-cols-12). Hero widgets span 8 cols, feeds span 4.
Cards: 'Tracing Beam' style. 1px border that glows on hover.
Spacing: Use generous internal padding (p-6) within bordered containers.

buttons.style: Sharp edges (rounded-sm or rounded-none). Uppercase text.

cards.content: Always include a header, body, and footer section.

inputs.style: bg-black border border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary font-mono rounded-none

charts.style: Minimalist. Hide axes lines if possible. Use neon strokes. Add grid lines (stroke='#1F1F1F').

textures: Scanline overlay (pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50 opacity-[0.03])
effects: Glitch: On hover for key headers (optional)

economics.alt: Abstract particles in sphere representing economics

technology.alt: Glowing AI chip on circuit board

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Control Room' grid layout for the main dashboard.
Use the provided image URLs for the category cards.
Ensure all text contrast meets APCA standards.
Use 'Azeret Mono' for all headings to enforce the terminal aesthetic.
Use 'Manrope' for body text to ensure readability.
Keep the existing 'Scanline' effect in index.css.
Update the Tailwind config to include the new colors if needed (though they seem to match existing variables).
Create a 'PredictionCard' component that uses the 'Tracing Beam' border effect.
Ensure the 'Live Events' feed looks like a scrolling terminal log.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
